title: ha-notice notification (input)
description: The JSON object read by send --stdin-json or --file. Unknown fields exit 20 invalid_payload. Sanitizing, the cut of a title to 256 characters after sanitizing, the empty-message check and the command-keyword check are applied by the tool and are not expressible here.

title.description: Untrusted. At most 100000 characters of input (more is exit 20 invalid_payload); cut at 256 characters after sanitizing with an ellipsis and truncated: true; one line (newlines become spaces).

message.description: Untrusted. At most 100000 characters of input; must not be empty after sanitizing and must not be a command message.

link.description: Syntactic gate only: http or https URL, no whitespace or control characters, no userinfo, at most 1024 characters. The tool names link_invalid or link_scheme.
